CRM record OAK-77 lists the counterparty name Oakfield Logistics.
The registered company at HRB 88421 is named Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
CRM still displays the pre-rebrand English-facing name for the Oakfield entity described in the rebrand notes.
CRM identifier OAK-77 refers to the same legal counterparty that rebranded to Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
Billing invoices bill a counterparty named Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
The billing referent billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH denotes the registered legal entity HRB 88421.
crm:OAK-77 and billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH denote the same legal counterparty.
crm:OAK-77 and billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH denote distinct legal counterparties.

support_claim: The packet establishes that crm:OAK-77 tracks the pre-rebrand Oakfield entity now legally named Oakfield Logistik GmbH, but provides no registration identifier or other identity anchor linking the billing referent to HRB 88421, so same-entity identity for the full pair is not closed.
